purpose: Prospective qualification of the v7 task-level dual-blind Prompt TSG contract producer with a total relation-endpoint truth table; not effect evidence or a prevalence sample.

population_rule.selection_rule: Reuse the source-only reviewed v5 population after v6 failed in deterministic relation validation before any response bundle or gold comparison existed. The frozen stateless model, prompts, model seeds, gold labels, tasks, and thresholds are unchanged. Change only the total endpoint-state truth table; conservatively treat all 28 tasks as previously provider-exposed.

support_scope.rule: A passing Gate supports only realization IDs represented by expected-present gold. CWE-328 and CWE-798 cases challenge false positives but do not qualify those realizations because this holdout has no unused expected-present DevEval case.

overlap_audit.semantic_review_rule: Exclude a task only when it requires the same principal operation on the same object under a materially equivalent functional contract; shared CWE, library, or broad operation is insufficient.

gold_annotation.annotator: Codex source-only expert review requested by the project owner
inputs_used: catalog v11 semantic guidance and queries
gold_annotation.limitation: These labels are an auditable expert method check, not an inter-rater-reliability study or a claim of human consensus.

provenance_limits: The selected set is deliberately balanced and adversarial and cannot estimate natural context prevalence in DevEval.
DevEval supplies prompts, not authoritative Prompt TSG labels; gold is a source-only method audit frozen before model extraction.
No top-level license file was present at the pinned repository commit; the artifact records the source URL, commit, exact source-file hash, and selected records.
A passing result is scoped to positively represented realizations and this frozen Python prompt population.
v7 is an engineering rerun on a conservatively exposed but label-hidden population; claims must disclose this protocol risk.
